desc: While wearing this helm, you have telepathy with a range of 30 feet, and you can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{Detect Thoughts} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSuggestion]{Suggestion} (save DC 13) from the helm. Once either spell is cast from the helm, that spell can't be cast from it again until the next dawn.
name: helm of telepathy
